title: Closure via Last Payment
walkthroughSteps: Locate 'Section 004 — Payment Demo' (SEC-008) — Open, single blocker: hasOpenPayments=true
Open dev context menu (⋮) → 'Simulate Final Payment'
Observe: section auto-closes → status chip → Closed; toast 'Section auto-closed — final payment received'
All other sections on CLM-2024-001 are also Closed → claim auto-closes
Navigate to Overview — verify Claim status = Closed; check activity log for System entry
To test blocked case: use SEC-002 (hasActiveLitigation=true + hasOpenReserves=true + hasOpenPayments=true) and trigger 'Simulate Final Payment' — error toast fires, section stays Open

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Final payment auto-closes section — cascades to claim if last
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: Triggering 'Simulate Final Payment' on a section with only a payment blocker auto-closes it. If it's the last open section, the claim also auto-closes with retention date = closure + 10 years.

setup.description: SEC-008 ('Section 004 — Payment Demo') has hasOpenPayments=true and all other 6 blocker flags false. PAY-005 is a Pending, non-final payment linked to SEC-008. Close other open sections (SEC-001, SEC-002, SEC-003) first so that SEC-008 becomes the last open section, allowing the claim cascade to fire.

preconditions.text: SEC-008 status is Open with only hasOpenPayments=true, all other blocker flags false
PAY-005 exists with status=Pending, isFinalPayment=false, sectionId=SEC-008
All other CLM-2024-001 sections are Closed for the claim auto-close cascade

expectedUI.description: SEC-008 row updates to Closed chip; toast fires; claim status on Overview = Closed
visualCues: Toast: 'Section Section 004 — Payment Demo auto-closed — final payment received'
Activity log entry: user='System', objectType='Section', attribute='Status', valueOld='Open', valueNew='Closed'

howToTest.action: Click ⋮ → 'Simulate Final Payment' on 'Section 004 — Payment Demo' (SEC-008). Close other open sections first via ⋮ → Close Section if they are not already Closed.
howToTest.expectedResult: SEC-008 → Closed; toast fires; navigate to Overview → Claim = Closed with retention date

acceptanceCriteria.devNotes: Trigger chain: onSimulateFinalPayment() → triggerFinalPaymentAndClose() → triggerFinalPayment() marks PAY-005 isFinalPayment=true + status=Final → autoCloseSection() filters out payments blocker, calls closeSection(systemUser='system', 'Section Finalised') → toast → maybeAutoCloseClaim() → defaultRetentionDate() → patchOverview → maybeCloseLossEvent('LE98765432').

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Non-payment blockers prevent auto-close on final payment
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: When active litigation or reserves exist alongside the payment blocker, triggering 'Simulate Final Payment' fires an error toast and leaves the section Open.

setup.description: SEC-002 has hasActiveLitigation=true, hasOpenReserves=true, and hasOpenPayments=true. After filtering out the payments blocker, two blockers remain (litigation + reserves). PAY-003 provides the pending payment for SEC-002.

preconditions.text: SEC-002 has hasActiveLitigation=true and hasOpenReserves=true in addition to hasOpenPayments=true
PAY-003 (or PAY-004) exists as a Pending payment for SEC-002

expectedUI.description: Section stays Open; error toast shows blocker details
visualCues: Toast error: 'Simulate Final Payment failed' with message listing remaining blockers (litigation + reserves)
No activity log closure entry written for SEC-002

howToTest.action: Click ⋮ → 'Simulate Final Payment' on Section 002 (SEC-002) without clearing blockers.
howToTest.expectedResult: Error toast fires with blocker details; SEC-002 remains Open

acceptanceCriteria.devNotes: autoCloseSection() filters blockers excluding 'payments' type → finds litigation + reserves blockers still present → returns throwError() with blocker labels → catchError in onSimulateFinalPayment() fires toast.error('Simulate Final Payment failed', err.message). closeSection() is never called.

notes: PaymentEventListenerService (external BC event subscription) is out of prototype scope. The full auto-close chain is implemented and testable via dev context menu ('Simulate Final Payment'). Retention date formula: closureDate + 10 years, implemented in defaultRetentionDate() in claim-closure.service.ts. Demo section: SEC-008 ('Section 004 — Payment Demo'), demo payment: PAY-005. Loss event LE98765432 auto-closes if all linked claims are Closed.
